description: Questions with the flow the router is expected to choose. lookup = read the best passages (flow A); exact = answered from the metadata by SQL (flow B); unsupported = a kind of request the system cannot do yet and must say so. A case has either 'question' or 'golden_id' (the text is then taken from questions.json). Used by `corpus/cli.py routing-eval`, which only runs the planner.

cases.note: pinpoint: a case number, asks about that case
pinpoint: a case number, asks about that case
pinpoint: a case number, asks who represents a party
content question with a court and a year, no case number
synthesis over a period; stays on the passages flow for now

cases.question: Mi a különbség a 4.P.20.409/2023/4. és a 27.P.20.339/2021/37. számú ügy között?
cases.note: comparing two named cases: both documents are the anchors
adversarial: an invented case number must lead to a read that finds nothing, not to a filter that matches nothing
